INTRODUCING: The Restoring the Death Penalty in DC Act.

This legislation brings capital punishment back to our nation's capital for the most heinous crimes: first-degree murder, terrorism, the murder of law enforcement officers and public safety employees, child sexual abuse, and dealing deadly drugs to kids.

D.C. abolished the death penalty in 1980. For more than 46 years, capital punishment has been off the table in our nation's capital, and criminals have not paid the real price of justice.
